source: Pinned PyPI Windows wheels and UPX-packed copies
limitations: UPX versus packable public Windows wheel binaries only. Negative examples are assumed unpacked; they are not independently certified against other packers. The split is by PyPI project, not verified independent code lineage. Other packers, malware, signed binaries and other architectures are not represented.
